title: Optimizing Grafana Alert Routing to Reduce On‑Call Overhead
description: Learn how to route Grafana alerts to WakeUp Dev, use voice ACKs, and eliminate per‑seat costs with unlimited seats.
author: Enrique Drack
topic: Optimizing Grafana Alert Routing to Reduce On‑Call Overhead

blocks.text: When Grafana triggers an alert, the webhook payload lands on a Cloudflare Worker that forwards it to WakeUp Dev. The worker strips Grafana’s verbose metadata and sends only the essential fields to the WakeUp Dev API.

WakeUp Dev routes the alert to the on‑call engineer’s phone. The engineer hears a short prompt and presses *1 to ACK*. The ACK is sent back to WakeUp Dev via a TwiML and is recorded as a resolved alert, eliminating the need for a second call or a ticket.

items: No per‑seat licensing; each engineer gets a virtual seat for free.
Unlimited seats mean you can add new team members without extra cost.
Pay only for the voice alerts you actually make.

blocks.text: Traditional on‑call solutions charge per seat and per alert. With WakeUp Dev, you pay a flat rate per voice alert and get unlimited seats. In a 10‑engineer team, that’s a 70% reduction in licensing fees compared to most SaaS tools.

items: Keep the webhook payload minimal; only forward fields that the team cares about.
Use the severity field to map to different phone numbers or escalation groups.
Test the TwiML flow in a sandbox before deploying.
